visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: square image under a large year, opposite the text card
visualCharacteristics.structure: full-width band per milestone: rounded text card (title + paragraphs) | year + image
visualCharacteristics.columns: 2 halves on desktop, stacked on mobile (card first)

contentPattern: History timeline (source custom historytimeline element, ~30 entries). One row per milestone: cell 1 year ('2023'), cell 2 title heading + paragraph(s), cell 3 image. Rows are rendered as full-width bands; each band gets a cycling class (cards-timeline-band-1..3) for the alternating background treatment.
